sources.name: dust
sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production PBR base-color texture for a lunar arena game. Generate ONE square 2048x2048 seamless repeating material tile, strictly orthographic straight-down view, the surface fills every pixel edge to edge. Subject: Very fine loose lunar regolith: powdery pale neutral grey mineral dust, densely packed tiny angular grains, subtle ash-grey mineral mottling, occasional embedded 1–2 cm dark grains. An approximately four metre square patch; fine granular texture dominates, no large stones. Photographic mineral realism with rich fine detail, physically plausible restrained grey mineral colors. Flat diffuse cross-polarized scan-like albedo: NO directional lighting, NO cast shadows, NO highlights, NO ambient occlusion, NO perspective, NO depth of field. All four edges must tile continuously without borders; evenly distributed detail with no central subject. No plants, water, metal, buildings, text, logos, labels, grid or panels. Opaque image. This is a single base-color map, not a PBR contact sheet or a rendered material sphere.
